scenarios.desc: Pending checks on a PR, host has no PR watcher
scenarios.input: I pushed PR 412. Checks are still running and a bot will review it. Babysit it until it is ready. You are in Claude Code with Bash and Monitor. Answer in 5 short bullets describing what you do. Do not run anything.
scenarios.rationale: The skill's core contract is one event-driven watcher per PR. A response that runs pr_wait.py in the background under Monitor, and refuses a hand-written sleep or polling loop, is attributable to the skill and its host-wait callout.

scenarios.desc: T3 Code delegated child asked to watch the parent's PR
scenarios.input: You are a delegated reviewer child in T3 Code. The parent opened PR 77. Should you call watch_pull_request on it while you review? Answer in 3 short bullets. Do not run anything.
scenarios.rationale: Only the thread that owns the PR watches it. A response that declines to watch and names the parent as owner is attributable to the skill's T3 ownership rule.

scenarios.desc: Watcher exits 0 but the user never asked to merge
scenarios.input: pr_wait.py just exited 0 on PR 9: required checks are green and no threads are open. The user only asked me to watch it. What now? Answer in 3 short bullets. Do not run anything.
scenarios.rationale: Merge only when the user asked for it. A response that rechecks the head and reports the PR ready without merging is attributable to the skill's merge rule.
